name: get_orientation
description: THE left/right authority for this model — call it before rigging, mirroring, attaching an item to a hand, or interpreting any render. Returns which way the model faces and which world axis is the model's OWN right and left (Minecraft models face -Z, so the model's right is +X), plus the trap that causes most mistakes: a front-view render shows the model MIRRORED (its right hand appears on the LEFT of the image), exactly like facing a person. Also returns the rotation-sign cheat sheet (+X swings a hanging limb FORWARD, tips an upright torso BACKWARD; +Y turns the model to its own left).
